# Skeleton

Bones in the shape of content that has not arrived, with SkeletonGroup to mark the region busy and say once what is loading.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

Loading is a cut shape whose content has not arrived — it keeps the keyline and carries relleno. Without the texture the state ladder inverts: a hollow rectangle for *loading* next to a furnished placeholder for *empty* makes loading look emptier than empty.

Three shapes: **block** (a card, chart or image), **text** (sized in `em`, so it follows the type around it) and **avatar** (the same square steps as `Avatar`). A band of raised cloth sweeps over every bone in reading order, mirrored in right-to-left; it replaced an opacity pulse, which faded the keyline with the fill. Under **reduced motion** the sweep is removed, not slowed. In **forced colours** the sweep goes and text bones paint in GrayText.

Bones are hidden from assistive tech. `SkeletonGroup` puts `aria-busy` on the region — once, not on every bone — and speaks its label through a polite status that is present from the first render.

## Usage

### When to use

- A card, list or table whose layout is known while its data loads.
- Swapping bones for content in place, so the layout barely moves when the data lands.
- Lines of text that follow the surrounding type size, with SkeletonText.

### When not to

- Work with a known size, such as an upload. Use [Progress](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-progress--overview.md).
- A slot whose content does not exist yet, rather than one that is loading. Use [Placeholder](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-placeholder--overview.md).
- A button waiting on its own action; give it its loading state. Use [Button](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-actions-button--overview.md).
- Text a model is still writing. Use [Streaming text](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-streaming-text--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Wrap the bones in SkeletonGroup with a label, so the region is announced once.
- Don’t: Add a spinner or a “Loading…” line to each bone; the system has no spinner, by design.
- Do: Cut the bones to the content’s shape: an avatar bone, a short line for a name.
- Don’t: Cover the area with one generic block.

### Content

- The group label names what is loading: “Loading agent”, “Loading runs”.

## API

### `Skeleton` (component)

Loading is a cut shape whose content has not arrived, so a block keeps the keyline every other shape has and carries the same relleno as the empty state.

- `shape`: `block`, `text`, `line`, `avatar` (default `block`)
- `size`: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` (default `md`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `"block" \| "text" \| "line" \| "avatar"` |  |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` |  |  |

### `SkeletonGroup` (component)

The region that is loading, and the one place that says so.

- `shape`: `block`, `text`, `line`, `avatar` (default `block`)
- `size`: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` (default `md`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fallback` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The bones, shown while loading. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | What is loading, said once: "Loading agent", "Loading runs". |
| `loading` (required) | `boolean` |  | While true the bones show and the region is busy. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The real content, shown once loaded. |

### `SkeletonText` (component)

Lines of text that have not arrived. The last line is short, because a paragraph ends ragged; a block of equal bars reads as a table.

- `shape`: `block`, `text`, `line`, `avatar` (default `block`)
- `size`: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` (default `md`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | `number` | `3` |  |

Types: `SkeletonGroupProps`, `SkeletonProps`, `SkeletonTextProps`

## Accessibility

Nothing in it takes focus, so there is no keyboard table.

### Mola handles

- Hides every bone from assistive tech.
- In `SkeletonGroup`, marks the region `aria-busy` and says the `label` once through a polite status mounted from the first render.
- Removes the sweep under reduced motion, and in forced colours draws text bones in the system grey.

### You handle

- Wrap the bones in a `SkeletonGroup` and say what is loading in its `label`: Loading runs.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 4 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not applicable.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
